scope: Conceptual campus illustration. Geometry is recovered from the original procedural model; it is not a site plan or construction sequence.
adaptations: Restored full-campus procedural geometry in an ES module with local Three.js r170 dependencies.
Removed unsupported site-specific capacities, vendors and claims from labels.
Separated the on-site generation feeder from the high-voltage grid corridor.
Added camera presets, selectable systems, power and heat flow controls, reduced-motion behavior and lifecycle cleanup.
Made the roof translucent to expose the recovered electrical bay and rack rows.
